newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues 1-year term tender to buy diesel.
newsitem.headline: India issues 1-year term tender to buy diesel.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a one-year term tender to buy high speed diesel with the first cargo scheduled to be delivered in May, traders said on Friday.

The tender seeks 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes of 1.0 and 0.5-percent sulphur diesel for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast and the same cargo size to Kandla on the west coast, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
It also seeks 30,000-tonne cargoes of either grades for delivery to Goa or Kandla.
The tender indicates that one cargo is to be delivered to each port during the first two weeks of each month.
The tender closes on March 13 and offers will be valid until March 17.
In its last one-year term contract, IOC bought one cargo each from western trading house Cargill, Swiss trader Glencore and Dutch trader Vitol. That contract started from July 1996.
